bio.text: Kurt Alme is a Republican candidate for the U.S. Senate from Montana in 2026; he filed on March 4, 2026, and is a former U.S. Attorney for Montana.
He held the U.S. Attorney post from 2017 to 2020 and again from March 2025 until March 2026, and earlier led Gov. Greg Gianforte's budget office.

According to career information released by his campaign, he served as an Assistant U.S. Attorney from 2003 to 2010, earned his undergraduate degree at the University of Colorado and his law degree at Harvard Law School, and lives in Billings.

sources.title: Kurt Alme files for U.S. Senate, immediately endorsed by outgoing Sen. Daines, President Trump
